scenes.script: Arun says: Engane freeze aavaathe English samsaarikkaam? Ith nammalellaavarkkum ulla doubt aanu.
Arun says: Oru job interview clear cheyyaano, promotion kittano, athumallengil just confidence thonnano...
Arun says: Matthullavarude munnil respect nedanum stand out cheyyaanum namukk English venam.
Arun says: Pakshe pazhaya methods work aayilla. Karanam ningal books vaayichu, samsaarichilla. Pinne coaching classes-inu nalla time pokum.
Arun says: Athukondaanu ningalkku Supernova AI vendath. Meet Miss Nova, ningalude personal AI English teacher.
Arun says: Miss Nova-yodoppam ningalkku out loud samsaarichu practice cheyyaam. Ningal aayiram mistakes varuthiyaalum, Miss Nova ningale orikkalum kaliyaakilla.. judge-um cheyyilla.
Arun says: Ellavarkkum ore reethiyil alla avar padhippikyunnathu. Ningalude exact level manassilaaki, ningalkkaayi oru personalized plan avar tharum.
Arun says: Feeds scroll cheythu manikyoorugal kalayathe, ippoal padhikyunna 1 crore-il adhikam Indians-te oppam join cheyyoo.
Arun says: Avar mistakes correct cheyyumpol, logic Malayalathil explain cheyyum. So karyangal eluppathil manassilaakum.
scenes.on_screen_text: 4.6, Ratings and reviews, Play Store, BEST CHOICE

scenes.script: Arun says: Ith coaching classes-nekkal laabhamaanu. Divusavum just 15 minutes spend cheyyoo. Supernova AI install cheythu innu thanne samsaarichu thudangoo.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script was localized into colloquial, code-mixed Malayalam. Recast the character Rahul to Arun using the Malayalam casting table. Ensured the hook opens with a native Malayalam word ('Engane') to satisfy T7. Applied the Malayalam-specific overrides: 'speak' was translated using native verb stems ('samsaarikkaam', 'samsaarichu'), 'give' was correctly rendered as 'tharum' (2nd person), avoided English-noun + Malayalam-case-ending hybrids, used 'kaliyaakilla' instead of literal laughing for mocking, and correctly translated time-unit words ('hours' to 'manikyoorugal' and 'days' to 'divusavum') while keeping digits intact. Addressed the viewer using the polite plural 'ningal' register.

violations.why: The visual depicts a 1 Rupee coin, which introduces an unapproved hard rupee price into the ad.
violations.fix: Remove the 1 Rupee coin drawing and replace it with a generic savings illustration like a piggy bank.

violations.why: The on-screen text 'BEST CHOICE' acts as an absolute superlative, which is prohibited.
violations.fix: Replace 'BEST CHOICE' with 'TRUSTED CHOICE' or 'TOP RATED'.

safety.summary: The ad contains a severe violation due to an unapproved hard rupee price visual (1 Rupee coin) and a moderate violation for using an absolute superlative ('BEST CHOICE').
